text:
Deputy National Chairman (North) of the All Progressives Congress (APC), Dr. Ali Bukar Dalori, has dismissed concerns over President Bola Ahmed Tinubu’s electoral prospects in the northern region.
He predicted that the 2027 general elections will produce landslide votes for the President across all 19 northern states and the Federal Capital Territory (FCT).
Dalori stated this while speaking to journalists in Maiduguri, preparatory to the president’s visit to commission a series of regional projects.
“Among the projects to be unveiled are 10,000 electric tricycles, 300 taxis, and 30 luxurious buses procured by the North-East Development Commission (NEDC) to cushion the effects of transportation costs for ordinary citizens,” he said.
Dismissing the insinuations that the north might not replicate their votes to the President due economic hardship, Dalori defended fuel subsidy removal as a “child of necessity”.
He explained that when the current administration assumed office, the national economy was still reeling from the severe shocks of the COVID-19 pandemic.
This situation, he noted, had forced the previous administration to sell crude oil in advance and accumulate heavy foreign loans to run the government.
“As a government of continuity, the president had no option but to immediately remove the subsidy in order to hit the ground running, therefore, by the Grace of Allah (God), the 2027 votes cast by Northerners for the President will shock critics and surprise Nigerians,” Dalori said.
Backing his claims, the DNC highlighted several major federal infrastructural projects in the northeast, where the Vice-President, Senator Kashim Shettima, hails from, and the entire North.
“In addition to the relative peace restored, we benefitted immensely under the APC led government, particularly the ongoing dualization of the Gombe-Biu-Maiduguri road corridor, Kano-Kaduna-Abuja dual carriage way, Maiduguri-Dikwa-Gamboru Ngala and Maiduguri-Monguno road projects.
“Others are the reconstruction of the Gombe- Dukku, Gombe- Bajoga-Potiskum and Gombe- Yola roads, while a six-span bridge linking Ngalda in Yobe State with Jigawa and Gombe State have been given the desired attention.
“Also, the full take up of services at the Federal Orthopaedic Hospital in Hawul Local Government Area of Borno State and that of Billiri in Gombe, are worthy to mention such interventions but few,” he stated.
He further stressed that going by the retinue of crowd that trooped out at most of the APC presidential campaign flag off, especially in Kaduna, Jigawa, Kebbi, Sokoto, Plateau and other Northern states, indicated that the second term victory of President Tinubu and the APC is sacrosanct come 2027.
“As we expect Mr. President’s visit, where he will commission numerous regional people oriented projects executed by the federal and state governments.
“People of Borno in particular are the most favored, having their son selected as Vice-President and Tinubu’s running mate for the second term” he said.
He therefore called on the people of the state to come out enmasse and conduct themselves peacefully as they receive their August Visitor before the end of this week.
